text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Real Mystery Solving: The Mystic Tiara 
and the Phantom Thief's Mansion"... What's 
this billboard? Looks fun!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
By all means! A game using the entire 
mansion... Fufu, my heart is racing with 
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the game begins, the master of the 
mansion sonorously explains the 
situation—apparently, a phantom thief has 
snuck into the estate.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Meaning if we find the phantom thief 
disguised as a servant within the time 
limit, we win!
choice_data_list: If our treasure gets stolen, we lose.
If our treasure gets stolen, we lose.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then... excuse me, maid over there. Could 
I speak with you for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The situation changes by the second. I 
want to conduct the interviews while 
everyone's still here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is always a girl of action. 
It's probably best if I focus on 
supporting her so we can resolve this 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This detached building is quite run-down, 
isn't it? Still... places hidden from view 
like this might have some clues tucked 
away~...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh? The armor's cape looks newer compared 
to the armor's era! Which means... could 
this be the Phantom Thief's cape?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, something might have just flashed up 
there! Trainer, could you lift me up? I'd 
like to take a closer look.
choice_data_list:
Sure, but it might be dangerous if you 
lose your balance.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see... Captain, would you mind lifting 
the Trainer up for me?

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Ha! Pardon me, then... Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of clues might be in 
this garden—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's the other detectives! Hello 
there♪ Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text:
I was just gathering clues right now. And 
what I found was...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
A slipped-off shoe and broken lipstick... 
I see!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we went to all the places we could 
go, right?
choice_data_list:
Judging from the floor plan of the 
mansion, at least

Judging from the floor plan of the 
mansion, you know

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you took notes on where all the hints 
were! That's our Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case, all the physical evidence 
should be accounted for. We're so close to 
solving it, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing her having fun put me at ease as 
well. Just as I was about to ask if there 
was anything else I could help with—"

text_block_list.name: Lord of the Manor
text_block_list.text: Nowaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, that voice just now...

text_block_list.name: Lord of the Manor
text_block_list.text: Th-The Tiara is... gone from the safe~~!?

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...Wait, huh? It's not Game Over, 
which means—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—The phantom thief is still inside the 
mansion! Maybe the tiara is too big to 
carry around, and they're having trouble 
getting it out?

text_block_list.name: Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! So not only the phantom thief, but 
I also have to find the hidden tiara...

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this, let's split up 
and search! Both the phantom thief and the 
tiara are still inside the mansion, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Alright, here's our chance!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, follow me quietly, okay? We 
should be able to catch the phantom thief 
right now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's check this bookshelf... and done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLUNK, rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I knew there was a secret room♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hidden passages behind bookshelves 
are actually pretty common, you know. As 
escape routes for important figures!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"And this very situation, with everyone 
panicking and scattering in all 
directions—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect chance to slip out 
with the tiara without getting noticed... 
right?♪

text_block_list.name: Maid
text_block_list.text: !? Why are you here...?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! So you really were the phantom 
thief. After all, your toes were pointed 
toward the safe the entire time.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
People tend to point their toes toward 
whatever they're interested in♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 'why are you even here when 
you haven't solved the mystery!?' ambush 
operation was a complete success!
choice_data_list: I feel like that's almost cheating...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I am honored by your praise.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding! It's been a while since we 
traded mind games like that, so I got a 
little fired upâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was impressed by how casually she spoke 
of it. It was a moment that made me truly 
appreciate Fine Motion's thoughtfulness...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, definitely. Even the maid looked 
totally taken aback.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However... in an emergency, rather than 
being bound by custom and common sense, 
one should respond flexibly, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not doing anything that would 
inconvenience the staff. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion wore a meaningful smile. Her 
expression was so enigmatic, all I could 
do was nod...
